notes: 12 garden bugs weighted by crops from seeds.json. Beneficial + common pests kids meet in veggie gardens.

bugs.name: Ladybug
bugs.line: A ladybug! These spotted helpers eat tiny aphids that harm plants. Tap to learn more.

bugs.name: Rolly Polly
bugs.line: A rolly polly — also called a pill bug! It rolls into a ball and helps break down old leaves. Tap to learn more.

bugs.name: Earthworm
bugs.line: An earthworm! Worms make tunnels that help roots breathe and soil stay soft. Tap to learn more.

bugs.name: Honeybee
bugs.line: A honeybee! Bees carry pollen so flowers can make fruit. Tap to learn more.

bugs.name: Butterfly
bugs.line: A butterfly! Some butterflies visit flowers for nectar while their caterpillars nibble leaves. Tap to learn more.

bugs.name: Garden Ant
bugs.line: A garden ant! Ants tidy soil and sometimes farm aphids for sweet dew. Tap to learn more.

bugs.name: Aphid
bugs.line: An aphid — a tiny sap-sucker. Ladybugs love to eat them. Tap to learn more.

bugs.name: Caterpillar
bugs.line: A caterpillar! It munches leaves now and may become a moth or butterfly later. Tap to learn more.

bugs.name: Garden Spider
bugs.line: A garden spider! Many spiders catch pest insects in their webs. Tap to learn more.

bugs.name: Grasshopper
bugs.line: A grasshopper! It hops through the garden and nibbles green leaves. Tap to learn more.

bugs.name: Garden Snail
bugs.line: A garden snail! It slides on a slime trail and likes cool, damp leaves. Tap to learn more.

bugs.name: Praying Mantis
bugs.line: A praying mantis! This hunter waits still, then catches other insects. Tap to learn more.
